fact: NIDA lists online TIN registration among the services delivered through its consent-based eKYC.

Tanzania Revenue Authority trainers said on 27 January 2026 that the IDRAS integrated domestic tax system, due to start on 9 February 2026, lets a parent obtain a TIN for a child and requires existing TIN holders to reset passwords.
NIDA lists the Tanzania Revenue Authority's taxpayer registration among the services integrated with the national ID.
